name: Phi Hồng, Flying Red (Phi Hồng Kiếm)
lore: Half of the twin swords Đào Tân Phân forged from one peach branch hardened by a thousand springs, and decreed that whoever holds both leads Lạc Anh Phái (C063). Diệp Phi Hồng kept this one when the school split (C109, C012), carried it into the rain forest in 648 and taught its art to no one (C133). Nghê Hồng Đậu found it in 910 (C168) and built her manor around it. She has never opened its art.
build_use: A Wood sword that reads the foe's poison: the mistress's blade, half asleep without its pair.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Gourd of Longing (Tương Tư Hồ Lô)
lore: A bottle gourd grown on the first trellis at Tiêu Âm Mạch, above the grave of Hàn Tư Quân, and dried for the bean poison. Nghê Xuân Chi has carried it since she took the garden.
